about: Settings for the weekly discovery job (pipeline/qcl_discover.py) and the queue ranking (pipeline/qcl_rank.py). Edit by hand; the job never changes this file.
labs_note: Each lab's current (latest) model family, as a model-name prefix. A new model from a listed lab that matches none of its prefixes is reported in docs/QUEUE.md as a possible new family and is not queued until its prefix is added here. Labs with an empty list are watched for new families only.
